scope: Registered stock-play scene; reference versus estimated material-force feedback, both with MPM particle dynamics
initial_state_validation: Recomputed SHA256 for every array in each initial_state.npz and checked metadata and pair equality
stock_scene_validation: Verified stock_config.json and scene_config.json hashes; their only configuration difference is sim.physics.use_cuda_graph true to false. num_envs=1 is part of both snapshots. Headless collection subsequently suppresses visualizers and automatic recorders. Native replay uses saved visualizer settings.
metric_definition: Force accuracy is computed within each trajectory against its own MPM contact solve, never by subtracting force profiles from the two different robot trajectories.
material_phase_definition: Any foot's MPM material force magnitude exceeds 20 N. This excludes unloaded rigid-platform approach intervals from the primary error metric.
direct_support_sampling: Rigid-floor/platform force sampled after the final rigid substep; material feedback applies over the coupled interval. Curves are not identical-time quadrature measurements.

video_metadata.presentation: Synchronized from time zero; shared recorded duration only. Each panel resized equally to 960 pixels wide. Labels outside scene. No scene recoloring or camera changes.

force_timestamp: Start of each coupled physics interval

metadata.evaluation: MPM particle velocities supplied to independent force reconstruction; MPM feedback drives G1.
metadata.force_convention: World-frame force and torque about each foot body COM, order [Fx,Fy,Fz,Tx,Ty,Tz].
metadata.reference_timing: reference_wrench is generated this step; applied_wrench is lagged feedback entering this step.
metadata.jitter_definition: Full width in meters of independent per-axis uniform offsets [-jitter/2, jitter/2]
metadata.task_preservation: Registered task defaults retained for geometry, material, commands, resets, actuation and solver settings. Only num_envs=1, CUDA graphs disabled for instrumentation, and headless visualizer/video-recorder suppression differ. Collection stops at the first native termination.

estimator.surface_velocity_approximation: instantaneous COM twist; MPM uses forward finite rotation
estimator.input_velocity: MPM proxy input after lagged-wrench rewind; no additional gravity or actuation

rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.quantity: Force exerted by selected rigid ground shapes on each robot foot, world xyz, newtons
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.timing: Last 0.0025 s rigid substep in each 0.005 s coupled step; not a substep average
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.foot_order: Same order as foot_body_ids and estimated/reference wrenches
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.state_effect: Diagnostic buffers only; does not change task contact observations or feedback

generalized_force_telemetry.coordinate_order: MJWarp generalized velocity order; includes floating-base coordinates
generalized_force_telemetry.timing: MJWarp buffers retained after the last 0.0025 s rigid substep of each 0.005 s coupled step; not a time average over the coupled step
generalized_force_telemetry.joint_force: Newton feed-forward effort before integration; native actuator forces are separate
generalized_force_telemetry.estimator_use: Diagnostics only; estimator receives proxy free motion and particle velocities

metadata.rigid_contact_count_definition: MJWarp nacon after the final rigid substep, all rigid contacts including self contact; excludes material-particle contacts
metadata_corrections: Renamed material_asset_initial_rotation_wxyz to material_asset_initial_rotation_xyzw: native configuration quaternion order is XYZW. Values and simulation unchanged.
